novel_features.name: Cross-Instance Workflow Diff
novel_features.description: Diff workflow inventories between two n8n instances — missing, active mismatches, name changes.
novel_features.rationale: Requires simultaneous API access to two instances with configurable auth per target, impossible from a single-instance MCP server.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use before GitOps promotions to verify staging matches production without manual inspection.

novel_features.name: Instance Health Compare
novel_features.description: Side-by-side workflow counts and reachability for two n8n instances.
novel_features.rationale: Requires probing two separate instances at once — single-instance MCPs cannot do cross-environment comparisons.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when verifying failover readiness or multi-tenant deployment parity.

novel_features.name: Stale Workflow Detection
novel_features.description: List workflows not updated within N days — find dormant automations before they become liabilities. Requires a local sync first: `n8n-pp-cli sync`.
novel_features.rationale: Requires joining update timestamps across all workflows in the local store; single API calls return paginated lists without time-window filtering.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when auditing automation health or preparing for n8n upgrades.

novel_features.name: Credential Reference Audit
novel_features.description: Cross-reference every credential with the workflows using it — find unused and high-impact credentials. Requires a local sync first: `n8n-pp-cli sync`.
novel_features.rationale: Requires joining credential records with parsed workflow node definitions — only possible after full sync of both resources.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use before rotating credentials or deleting unused ones to avoid breaking active workflows.

novel_features.name: Node Type Inventory
novel_features.description: Count every n8n node type across all workflows — map your automation footprint and audit community node dependencies. Requires a local sync first: `n8n-pp-cli sync`.
novel_features.rationale: Requires parsing the nodes array of every synced workflow JSON and aggregating counts — a cross-workflow analysis impossible in a single API call.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use before upgrading community nodes to find every workflow that would be affected.

novel_features.name: Workflow Dependency Map
novel_features.description: Map execution chains via executeWorkflow nodes — see what calls what and who would break if a workflow is deleted. Requires a local sync first: `n8n-pp-cli sync`.
novel_features.rationale: Requires scanning the parameters of every node across all workflows to find executeWorkflow references — a deep local join not available via any single API endpoint.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use before deleting or refactoring a workflow to find all callers in the dependency chain.

novel_features.name: Execution CI Gate
novel_features.description: Poll an execution until it reaches a terminal state — blocks CI/CD pipelines on real n8n workflow results.
novel_features.rationale: Requires long-polling the executions API with typed exit codes (0 success, 1 error, 2 timeout) that map to CI system expectations.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use in CI scripts to block a deployment until an n8n data migration or validation workflow completes. Typed exit codes: 0 = success, 1 = error/canceled, 2 = timeout (distinct from global code 2 = usage error).

novel_features.name: Runaway Trigger Detection
novel_features.description: Flag workflows executing above a per-minute threshold — catch infinite loops and webhook storms before they degrade instance health. Requires a local sync first: `n8n-pp-cli sync`.
novel_features.rationale: Requires time-window aggregation across execution records in the local store; the n8n API returns executions but not rate analytics.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when n8n instance is slow or execution queue is growing to quickly identify the culprit workflow.

novel_features.name: Variable Drift Detection
novel_features.description: Compare environment variables between two n8n instances — find missing keys or value mismatches before deployment.
novel_features.rationale: Requires authenticating to two separate n8n instances simultaneously; single-instance MCPs cannot do cross-environment variable comparison.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use as a pre-deployment gate to ensure all required variables are set on the target instance.

novel_features.name: Bulk Workflow Management
novel_features.description: Activate, deactivate, or archive multiple workflows at once filtered by tag or name — hours of clicking replaced by one command.
novel_features.rationale: The n8n UI and API only expose per-workflow operations; bulk changes require iterating the full list and calling each endpoint individually.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use before maintenance windows or environment teardowns to disable entire workflow sets safely.

novel_features.name: Execution History Export
novel_features.description: Export structured execution history filtered by workflow, status, and time window for audit logs and analytics pipelines. Requires a local sync first: `n8n-pp-cli sync`.
novel_features.rationale: Requires querying the local store with composite filters (workflow + status + time window) in a single pass — the n8n API paginates executions without all these filter combinations.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to feed execution audit trails into SIEM, data warehouses, or compliance reporting pipelines.

narrative.headline: Every n8n feature from the terminal — workflow management, execution triage, GitOps sync, multi-instance health, and analytics no other tool ships.
narrative.value_prop: n8n-pp-cli gives agents and engineers full programmatic control over n8n: manage workflows, credentials, and executions without opening the UI. Sync your instance to local SQLite for offline analytics, cross-workflow dependency mapping, and stale-automation detection. Diff and compare two instances side-by-side for safe GitOps promotions.
narrative.auth_narrative: Set N8N_API_KEY (from Settings > API > Create an API key) and N8N_BASE_URL. The CLI sends the key as X-N8N-API-KEY on every request — no Bearer prefix needed. Run 'n8n-pp-cli doctor' to verify connectivity.

quickstart.comment: Verify N8N_API_KEY and N8N_BASE_URL are set and the instance is reachable
List all workflows with structured output for agent consumption
Sync all resources to local SQLite for offline queries and analytics
Find workflows not updated in 90 days

troubleshoots.fix: export N8N_API_KEY=<your-key> — generate one at Settings > API > Create an API key
Your API key may lack required scopes — check n8n Settings > API for permissions
Verify N8N_BASE_URL points to your n8n instance (include https://, no trailing slash)

troubleshoots.symptom: workflows stale / credentials audit returns empty
troubleshoots.fix: Run 'n8n-pp-cli sync' first to populate the local store

narrative.when_to_use: Use n8n-pp-cli when you need to manage n8n workflows programmatically from CI/CD, scripts, or an AI agent. It covers the full n8n API surface with structured JSON output, offline analytics via local SQLite, and cross-instance diff/compare operations that the n8n UI and standard MCPs cannot perform.
